gloss: lost property report; report of lost items

definitions.gloss: lost property report; report of lost items
definitions.explanation: An official report filed at a police station or other authority when personal belongings have been lost.

examples.japanese: {遺失届|いしつとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I filed a lost property report.

examples.japanese: ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくした⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{遺失届|いしつとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I lost my wallet, so I filed a lost property report at the police box.

examples.japanese: {遺失届|いしつとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧おけば、⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: If you file a lost property report, you will be contacted when the item is found.

notes:
A compound of {遺失|いしつ} (loss of property) and {届|とどけ} (notification/report). This is the formal term for the report filed with Japanese police when you lose something. Japan has a remarkably high rate of lost items being returned, so filing a {遺失届|いしつとどけ} is a practical step that often leads to recovery.

The full formal name is {遺失届出書|いしつとどけでしょ}, but {遺失届|いしつとどけ} is the common shortened form.
